## About Grand Cadaver

Grand Cadaver was formed in Gothenburg and Stockholm in the pandemic year of 2020. Every member has been a part of the Swedish extreme metal scene since their youth and many were part of shaping the first wave of Death Metal in the late 80’s. Grand Cadaver is all about that classic Swedish HM-2 sound! The debut EP ”Madness Comes” was recorded over 3 days in August of 2020 and was released to critical acclaim by Majestic Mountain Records in February 2021, reaching 9th place on the Swedish Album Charts (Physical Copies). Shortly thereafter the band returned to Welfare Sounds studio to record the debut album, "Into the Maw of Death", which was released on October 29th the same year. Once again to great acclaim, and landing a multitude of positive reviews. "The triumph of Into The Maw Of Death is in its ability to take a path into OSDM that doesn’t sound like every other revivalist band; there’s a menacing streak to it and an enduring love of death metal of all stripes that shines through" (Distorted Sound Mag) When the restrictions of the pandemic were lifted, Grand Cadaver made their debut live show in Gothenburg, followed by a short tour in support of At The Gates. The final show was at the Gefle Metal Festival Winter Edition. With the increased activity of the members' other bands, Grand Cadaver had to slow down the pace a tad, but entered the studio once again in the fall of 2022. The second album "Deities of Deathlike Sleep" was released on August 25, 2023. "Deities of Deathlike Sleep is their second stab. It’s along the same lines as their first: Swedish death metal done the right way." (Decibel Magazine) "‘Deities Of Deathlike Sleep’ is another excellent album from Grand Cadaver who do their ode to the old school Swedish death metal sound but add their own twists and turns into the sound ensuring that they don’t sound like yet another Entombed, Dismember or Carnage carbon copy. This is ripping old school death metal with a sinister doomy mood to it and definitely a recommended listen." (The Razor's Edge) "With Grand Cadaver, you know you’re getting top-tier musicianship, top-tier song writing, and one of the best vocalists in the game, and if they set the bar with Into the Maw of Death, they more than exceeded it on Deities of Deathlike Sleep." (Metal Epidemic)

ESAGON Cadaver Course
Advanced Ovarian Cancer Surgery
From Surgical Anatomy to Surgical Mind
Under the auspices ofAdvanced ovarian cancer surgery remains one of the most complex and demanding fields in gynecologic 
oncology and continues to represent one of the best models for understanding complex oncologic 
surgery.
Over the years, cytoreductive surgery has evolved from a predominantly technical procedure into 
a process driven by anatomy, surgical strategy, patient selection, and clinical judgment. Successful 
surgery no longer depends only on technical skills, but on the surgeon’s ability to understand anatomical 
planes, define the appropriate surgical indication, anticipate operative challenges, and recognize the 
limits of radicality.
At the same time, the progressive de-escalation of surgical treatment in selected patients and the 
reduced exposure to highly complex procedures have created new challenges for surgical education. 
Future surgeons will have fewer opportunities to acquire experience through direct exposure to highly 
complex procedures.
For this reason, modern surgical education must increasingly emphasize surgical reasoning, operative 
planning, multidisciplinary decision-making, and the ability to translate anatomical knowledge into 
sound surgical strategy.
Using advanced ovarian cancer surgery as its educational model, this course is designed to train not 
only technical skills but, above all, the Surgical Mind.
Advanced pelvic surgery, upper abdominal procedures, intestinal surgery, and pelvic and paraaortic lymphadenectomy are presented as components of a single integrated anatomical and strategic 
pathway.
Who should attend
This course is intended for gynecologic oncologists and surgeons wishing to:
• Develop advanced surgical judgment. • Strengthen anatomy-based decision-making. • Understand the indications and limitations of open, laparoscopic, and robotic surgery. • Improve operative planning before entering the operating room. • Integrate anatomy, surgical strategy, and clinical reasoning into daily practice.
Course format
• One morning of interactive theory (09:00–13:00): Building the Surgical Mind • One and a half days of cadaver dissection. • High tutor-to-participant ratio. • Structured debriefing following each practical session. • Integration of operative planning, anatomical dissection, and clinical discussion. • Surgical technique presented as the logical consequence of anatomy, strategy, and sound 
clinical judgment.

## Program

This two-day intensive course will give advanced knowledge of the safe use of dermal fillers, neurotoxins, and biostimulators under ultrasound control. This program is a very detail-oriented, comprehensive program for medical and dental doctors who are interested in integrating this specialty into their practice.
